ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the title of the table in the figure is "Virtual water content of some agricultural products in Israel in 1999". It lists the virtual water content of products such as barley, wheat, bananas, citrus, carrots, vegetables, and dairy cattle, beef cattle, poultry, and laying hens. In the table, carrots are about 0.064, vegetables about 0.069, bananas about 0.252, and citrus about 0.64, with relatively low values; wheat and barley are relatively high, and livestock products such as dairy cattle, beef cattle, poultry, and laying hens have even higher values, especially dairy cattle at about 177.8 and laying hens at about 31.09. Then reason: virtual water resources indicate the amount of water resources needed to produce goods and services; from the perspective of ecologically sustainable development, agricultural sectors with low water consumption per unit product and low pressure on water resources should be developed first. In the table, low-virtual-water products are mainly concentrated in horticultural products such as vegetables and fruits, so the development direction of Israel's agriculture should be mainly horticulture.

ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Virtual water resources refer to the amount of water resources needed to produce goods and services. Read the table and answer the question: <image1> From the perspective of ecologically sustainable development, what should be the main development direction of Israel's agriculture?
ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the title of the table in the figure is "Virtual water content of some agricultural products in Israel in 1999". It lists the virtual water content of products such as barley, wheat, bananas, citrus, carrots, vegetables, and dairy cattle, beef cattle, poultry, and laying hens. In the table, carrots are about 0.064, vegetables about 0.069, bananas about 0.252, and citrus about 0.64, with relatively low values; wheat and barley are relatively high, and livestock products such as dairy cattle, beef cattle, poultry, and laying hens have even higher values, especially dairy cattle at about 177.8 and laying hens at about 31.09. Then reason: virtual water resources indicate the amount of water resources needed to produce goods and services; from the perspective of ecologically sustainable development, agricultural sectors with low water consumption per unit product and low pressure on water resources should be developed first. In the table, low-virtual-water products are mainly concentrated in horticultural products such as vegetables and fruits, so the development direction of Israel's agriculture should be mainly horticulture.
